name: phi-guard
description: Blocks PHI in prompts and masks it in Bash output before it reaches the model, using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails.

guardrail_id.title: Guardrail ID
guardrail_id.description: GuardrailId output of the infra/guardrail.yaml stack

guardrail_version.title: Guardrail version
guardrail_version.description: GuardrailVersion output of the infra/guardrail.yaml stack

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region the guardrail is deployed in, for example us-east-1

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Optional AWS profile with bedrock:ApplyGuardrail permission. Leave empty to use the default credential chain.
